verdict.rationale: Ramp's own materials claim real-time bidirectional sync with ERPs that eliminates manual journal entries. They also say Ramp auto-categorizes transactions and syncs coded transactions directly to the ERP, and they list a broad set of native accounting integrations (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks Online/Desktop, Xero, Workday, Dynamics 365 and others). The Banking API adds a syncable-transactions endpoint for pushing banking transactions to an accounting provider. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on sync behavior (field mapping, sync frequency, expense/reimbursement coverage per integration) and any independent or hands-on corroboration that the sync works as claimed.
